review_candidates.title: Information Technology Operations Specialist

Role Description: Information Technology Operations Specialist is a full-time, remote role responsible for ensuring the stability and reliability of the company’s IT infrastructure and services. The role also involves maintaining documentation of IT procedures, supporting security and backup practices, and collaborating with other departments to optimize technology
